Supplementary Material: Table 1 – Search strategy

 SOURCES
 Searched were conducted in different sources from inception until
 7th January 2024
                                                                         Medline (via Ovid), PubMed, APA PsycARTICLES (via Ovid), APA PsycEXTRA (via Ovid), APA PsycINFO (via Ovid),
 Electronic databases
                                                                         EMBASE (via Ovid), Web of Science, CINAHL Plus (via EBSCOhost) and Cochrane Library
 Grey literature                                                         Google Scholar
 Journals                                                                Annals of Emergency Dispatch and Response (AEDR)
 Other sources                                                           References from other literature reviews and journals
 SEARCH TERMS
 Search terms included sources based on the PICOS criteria and the
 combined use of MeSH terms and Boolean operators
 Call-handlers and dispatchers                                           (call handl* OR dispatch* OR emergenc* call handl* OR emergenc* call handl* OR emergenc* dispatch* OR
 Emergency call-handlers, emergency dispatchers, emergency               emergenc* call* cent* OR emergenc* dispatch* cent* OR emergenc* call* OR emergenc* communicat* OR
 communications, call centres, crisis calls                              Emergenc* med* communicat* OR Call* operator* OR emergenc* call* tak* OR cris?s call*)
 Mental health and wellbeing                                             AND (stress* OR trauma* OR mental health OR well being OR wellbeing OR ptsd OR post traumatic stress disorder
 Stress, trauma, mental health, wellbeing, post-traumatic stress         OR anxiet* OR depressi* OR resilien* OR post trauma* adj3 growth) (MeSH exploded)
 disorder, anxiety, depression, post-traumatic growth, resilience
 LANGUAGE RESTRICTIONS
 Research team included at least one professional fluent in any of the
 mentioned languages
 Language                                                                English, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese
